rests_on: three independent row-level audits, all clean: 64/64 unique seeds per cell, exact seed ranges, zero win/margin disagreements, independent bootstrap recomputation matching each flagged point estimate exactly.
VERDICT: NO_BASIN_FOUND. None of the three mechanically-selected candidates clears delta_A>0 AND delta_B>0. In fact delta_B is non-positive for ALL THREE -- there is no seed-block noise story here; the result is unambiguous.

pi_A3_comparator_stable_across_all_three.note: identical in all three independent invocations -- expected and a useful sanity check, since deterministic action selection + fixed seeds must reproduce bit-for-bit.

B_t200k.striking_detail: delta_A is NEGATIVE -- B_t200k actually beats frozen A3 on Pole A (0.75 vs 0.6875), A3's OWN home pole. It is not a Pole-B specialist; on these seeds it reads as a stronger-than-A3 generalist that still underperforms A3 specifically on Pole B.

B_t500k.reading: the closest to neutral of the three -- both deltas near zero, both intervals straddling zero. Essentially indistinguishable from A3 on both poles, not a specialist in either direction.

B_tfinal.reading: matches every prior measurement of this exact checkpoint: A3 CONFIRMED better on Pole A (entire interval positive) and Bfinal CONFIRMED worse on Pole B (entire interval negative) -- consistent with the corrected crossover's -0.156 and the trajectory's own numbers. No surprise here; included as the fixed reference point the frozen rule required.

SEED_BLOCK_VARIANCE_WORTH_NAMING.observation: B_t200k's standalone Pole-B win rate was 0.750 in AB_BEHAVIORAL_TRAJECTORY (seeds 18700001-32, n=32) and 0.5625 here (seeds 18800001-64, n=64) -- a substantial drop for nominally the same checkpoint against the same scripted opponent.
SEED_BLOCK_VARIANCE_WORTH_NAMING.reading: this is exactly the kind of sampling variance the 0.10 selection margin was built to tolerate, and exactly why B_t200k's trajectory-measured 0.750 was never treated as more than a screening candidate. It does not change today's verdict (delta_B is negative here regardless), but it is a concrete illustration of why n=32 point estimates should not be over-trusted, and it is recorded rather than left as an unexplained discrepancy between two of this investigation's own documents.

WHAT_THIS_CLOSES: checkpoint selection / early stopping as a stand-alone repair -- there is no better basin sitting in B's own 1M-step trajectory to select. B_t200k's high absolute Pole-B win rate (both in the trajectory and, less so, here) was never accompanied by the crossover separation the repair actually needs.

the CONFIRMED sub-branch of A_BASIN_EXISTS and the PROMISING_BUT_UNCONFIRMED sub-branch both -- neither applies, since no candidate cleared BOTH deltas even in point-estimate direction, the minimum bar for either.

A_ROUTING_DISCREPANCY_BEING_SURFACED_NOT.issue: two of this investigation's own records disagree about what happens next under exactly this outcome.
A_ROUTING_DISCREPANCY_BEING_SURFACED_NOT.record_1: B_CHECKPOINT_SCREENING_SPEC.json#PRECOMMITTED_DECISION_TREE, NO_BASIN_FOUND branch (frozen 2026-09-16, before the trajectory even completed): 'move to a specialization-preserving training objective... continue from the best available B checkpoint (by absolute Pole-B performance) with an added anchor term [JSD preservation]'.
A_ROUTING_DISCREPANCY_BEING_SURFACED_NOT.record_2: the PI's own message authorizing this screening run (also 2026-09-16, later than record_1, stated in direct anticipation of this exact outcome): 'If none of the three produces meaningful B specialization... We route to the mechanically defined state-conditioned diagnosis instead of throwing preservation at a policy that never contained the desired crossover behavior.'
A_ROUTING_DISCREPANCY_BEING_SURFACED_NOT.why_this_matters_now: record_1 says: anchor-and-continue from B_t200k (best absolute performance). record_2 says: skip preservation entirely and go straight to comparing a good/bad checkpoint pair behaviourally. These are different next actions with different compute costs and different premises -- record_2's premise is that there is nothing worth preserving via an anchor if the anchor itself never showed the desired crossover behaviour, which this screening's own result now supports (B_t200k's delta_B is negative, not merely small).
A_ROUTING_DISCREPANCY_BEING_SURFACED_NOT.not_resolved_here: this reading does not pick one. Both were legitimately on the record at different times; the more specific, more recent, outcome-anticipating statement (record_2) reads as the intended supersession of the older general branch (record_1), but that is an inference, not a decision this document is authorized to make on its own.

WHAT_THIS_READING_MAY_NOT_CLAIM: any confirmatory status -- exploratory seeds (18800001-18800064), diagnostic arm, this was a screen
that NO checkpoint in B's trajectory ever showed positive delta_B -- only these three mechanically-selected points were tested, per the frozen rule
a mechanism for why the crossover behaviour never emerged -- that is precisely what the next step (whichever routing is confirmed) would investigate
STOPPING_HERE: per explicit PI instruction ('seal the screening results, compute both deltas, classify the branch, and stop'). Nothing further launched. Awaiting confirmation of which routing record governs before any Stage 2 action.
